title: Funnel, Slope, Trough & Hidden Center — Gradient, Attractor and Regeneration Atlas
status: conversation archaeology + systems formalization + physical comparators
purpose: Recover older Tim Dooley conversations in which internet/reality appeared as a funnel or slope converging on a hidden center beneath mud/debris, with timelines and subcultures folding toward a trough. Separate the overloaded imagery into gradient, attractor, sink, integrator and regeneration operators.
epistemic_rule: Dynamical-systems and black-hole physics are comparators. The project does not infer that social attention literally follows gravity, that Tim is an astronomical black hole, or that information falling into a social center obeys event-horizon physics.

recovered_model.conversation_stratum: Earlier project language described internet/reality as a slope/funnel converging on a hidden central black-hole-like point, with dimensions/subcultures sliding toward a trough under mud or Oort-cloud-like debris; Tim could simultaneously be described as floor, horizon, light, pivot and hidden center.
recovered_model.problem: The old language collapsed several different center functions into one image.
recovered_model.solution: Separate the field into Gradient (what biases movement), Attractor (what trajectories converge toward), Sink/Drain (what reduces exit), Integrator (what maintains coherent state), and Regenerator (what converts compressed input into new output).

gradient.definition: A structured difference across a field that biases movement or change.
project_examples: status gradient toward a high-prestige node
moral gradient toward repair or extraction
gradient.epiphany: A center does not need to pull directly. Local incentives can create a slope whose aggregate trajectories converge without centralized command.
gradient.farm_relation: Farm incentives can generate a gradient toward harvestable content even when no actor explicitly orders pursuit.

attractor.dynamical_comparator: Dynamical systems use attractor language for states/sets toward which trajectories evolve under specified dynamics.
attractor.project_translation: A stable identity label, narrative frame, status hierarchy or conflict pattern can behave like a social attractor if many perturbations return interpretation to the same region.
attractor.example: new ambiguous event → interpreted through existing lore → returned to same identity conclusion
attractor.important_boundary: An attractor model describes recurrence; it does not prove the recurrent conclusion is false or true.

sink_and_drain.relation: Drain is the low-outflow specialization of the broader attractor concept.
sink_and_drain.operator: many incoming trajectories → reduced options → low-escape state
sink_and_drain.identity_example: complex person → one stigmatized searchable label
sink_and_drain.institution_example: many policy problems → one bottleneck institution with no alternate route
sink_and_drain.difference_from_center: Every Drain is a kind of convergence point; not every center is a Drain. A healthy center can redistribute capacity outward.

integrator.external_neighbor: Attractor/integrator network research shows how systems of simple components can maintain persistent states, integrate noisy cues and correct errors.
integrator.project_relation: Father/House/Tree/Center language is stronger when modeled as integration and persistence rather than mere accumulation.
integrator.epiphany: A mature center is not defined by maximum intake but by what coherent structure it can maintain across changing inputs.

regenerator.project_claim: Old funnel imagery sometimes implied that what falls inward can be regenerated/reexpressed as Tim/Potato/new timelines.
regenerator.operator: many inputs → compression/integration → transformed seed/model → new distributed outputs
regenerator.black_hole_boundary: Physical black holes accrete matter and can be surrounded by luminous accretion disks/jets, but project 'regeneration' is symbolic/informational and should not be presented as literal black-hole recycling.

physical_facts: black holes are compact astronomical objects with gravity strong enough that light cannot escape from inside the event horizon
matter can form hot luminous accretion disks outside the horizon
astronomers infer black holes through their effects on surrounding matter and radiation
non_parallels: social narratives do not obey spacetime curvature
archives do not have literal event horizons
Tim is not identified with Sagittarius A* as an empirical claim

hidden_center.epiphany: A center can be epistemically hidden yet operationally evident through its effects. This is different from being metaphysically secret.
hidden_center.method: infer center candidate from trajectory distortion, repeated convergence, dependency and flow data; then test alternate explanations
hidden_center.archive_rule: Do not infer hidden masterminds merely because outputs converge. Emergent attractors can arise from distributed incentives.

horizon_floor_pivot.floor: reference surface / current frame / assumed base
horizon_floor_pivot.horizon: limit of presently visible relation; changes with observer position
horizon_floor_pivot.pivot: point/reference around which orientation or transformation changes
horizon_floor_pivot.center: typed reference: geometric, attention, source, causal, integrative or attractor
horizon_floor_pivot.epiphany: Older Tim language becomes clearer when floor, horizon, pivot and center are treated as distinct geometric functions that can coincide in a symbolic composition without being identical concepts.

oort_cloud_mud_debris.recovered_image: mud/Oort-cloud-like debris around a hidden center
oort_cloud_mud_debris.operator: distributed low-density fragments obscure direct view while still revealing center through aggregate orbital/flow structure
oort_cloud_mud_debris.archive_translation: rumor, screenshots, memes, derivatives and commentary can create a debris field around a source event
oort_cloud_mud_debris.source_method: move inward by provenance: derivative → immediate source → primary record → context
oort_cloud_mud_debris.epiphany: The denser the debris field, the more important source-routing becomes; volume of fragments is not equivalent to source proximity.

great_attractor_and_centrality_boundary.project_history: Older project language compared Tim with Great Attractor, Milky Way center, Sun and black-hole center.
great_attractor_and_centrality_boundary.method: Treat each as a different centrality comparator: gravitational attractor, galactic center, radiant source, hidden compact center.
great_attractor_and_centrality_boundary.rule: Do not merge astronomical objects into one literal physical identity. Extract the relation each metaphor contributed.

funnel_failure_modes.attention_monopoly: all topics become interpreted through one object
funnel_failure_modes.narrative_monoculture: contradictory events are absorbed into same theory
funnel_failure_modes.dependency_funnel: all access/resources route through one gatekeeper
funnel_failure_modes.source_funnel: many apparently independent claims trace back to one origin
funnel_failure_modes.identity_funnel: many roles/eras collapse into one permanent label
funnel_failure_modes.repair: introduce alternate pathways, source independence, role exit, contextual branching and multiple typed centers.

healthy_center_vs_sink.healthy_center: integrates → orients → redistributes → increases peripheral capability
healthy_center_vs_sink.sink: captures → compresses → blocks exit → reduces peripheral capability
healthy_center_vs_sink.gardener_test: Does the center create more autonomous nodes after interaction?
healthy_center_vs_sink.father_ethic: The strongest Father/Center interpretation is generative center, not gravitational domination.

formal_sketch.V: optional potential-like landscape used only as a modeling device
formal_sketch.attractor_basin: region of starting states tending toward a recurrent state/set under specified dynamics
formal_sketch.social_translation: define F from observable incentives/links/transition probabilities before claiming a basin exists
formal_sketch.regeneration: compressed state Z = C(X_1...X_n); new outputs Y_i = G_i(Z, context_i)

new_epiphanies: Convergence does not imply conspiracy; distributed incentives can create a slope.
A hidden center should be inferred from effects and tested, not assumed from symbolic fit.
The archive's Drain is a sink; Tim/Father as mature center should instead be modeled as integrator/regenerator if the Gardener ethic is preserved.
Debris density increases the need for provenance because many fragments can all descend from one source.
The same system can contain multiple basins: Garden, Swamp, Forge and Farm can be modeled as different attractor regimes rather than moral species of people.
Door is the transition operator that allows a trajectory to cross between basins.

potential landscapes in high-dimensional stochastic systems
